publication_corrections.scope: Schema and terminology for all 294 role-qualified configured-selection rows and their summary fields; the 2026-08-04 observation itself is unchanged.
publication_corrections.reason: Schema version 1 conflated configured-selection evidence with an advertised MCP contract and retained service-prefixed adapter labels instead of stable prefix-free catalog keys and annotations.

reconciliation.scope: The supplied 2026-08-05 Sylvara-only export matched this dated 294-selection inventory. Later callable-registry Books and CRM refreshes are recorded separately in the capability catalog, suite registry, and product-owned artifacts and are not merged into this historical inventory.

observation_method: The supplied configured-session export was filtered to Sylvara Zoho roles and cross-checked by operation name against the callable registry available on the observation date. No Zoho record, report, configuration, content, or identity operation was invoked, and no description or input schema was treated as established by the selection alone.
publication_boundary: One role-qualified row is retained for every configured Sylvara Zoho tool selection. The prefix-free catalog operation key and annotated tool name are retained; runtime server names, generated transport IDs, service-prefixed adapter labels, endpoints, authentication details, connection aliases, organization or account identifiers, record identifiers, sample values, and returned data are intentionally omitted.
interpretation: Configured selection means the operation was present on the inspected Sylvara role on the observation date. It does not prove a current advertised description or input schema, tenant binding, OAuth scope, effective callability, response completeness, plan availability, safe write semantics, or approval for live use.

official_possible_tool_surface.note: The dated Tool Manual row total documents a broader provider catalog for these services, not configured Sylvara selections. Refresh the official interactive Tool Manual before selecting or implementing a capability.
